title: Wealth Management Client Discovery Script
description: Topics and questions the simulated client will raise during the meeting

topics.topic: Ask about the advisor's credentials and how long they've been with the firm
Mention why they're seeking financial advice now (life event or concern)
Ask how the advisor is compensated and if they are truly a fiduciary
Share current income situation and ask if it's enough to meet goals
Mention existing savings/investments and ask if they're in the right place
Ask about emergency fund adequacy
Discuss any significant debts and whether to pay them off vs invest
Ask when they want to retire and what that looks like
Discuss current retirement accounts (401k, IRA) and ask if they're optimized
Ask about Social Security and when to start collecting
Raise concern about outliving retirement savings
Ask about current investment portfolio and if it matches risk tolerance
Express confusion/concern about market volatility
Ask about alternative investments (real estate, private equity, etc.)
Inquire about investment fees and how to minimize them
Ask about tax-efficient investing strategies
Discuss Roth vs Traditional IRA conversion considerations
Ask about capital gains and tax-loss harvesting
Ask about life insurance needs and whether current coverage is adequate
Raise concern about long-term care costs
Ask about disability insurance
Ask about having a will and whether it needs updating
Discuss beneficiary designations and whether they're current
Raise question about leaving money to children/grandchildren
Ask about charitable giving strategies if applicable
Ask what the advisor recommends as immediate next steps
Ask how often they would meet and how accessible the advisor is
Express concern about trusting someone with their money
Ask about minimum investment requirements
